descriptionChirho: Proper noun referring to the Canaanite city of Eglon in the Shephelah lowlands of Judah, mentioned in Joshua's southern campaign and in tribal allotments. All occurrences across languages consistently transliterate the same toponym: eng 'Eglon / to-Eglon', spa 'Eglon / a-Eglon', arb 'عجلون / لِعِجْلون', kor '에글론 / 에글론을', swa 'Egloni / kwa-Egloni'. The two clusters differ only in prepositional prefixes (bare form vs. min-prefix), which are grammatical inflections of the same referent, not distinct senses.
